text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh? I've never seen this sort of dessert
before.
What could it be?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! "The Peak of Calories! Whipped
Cream
Mountain ☆ Ultra Rich
Pudding"?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I can just barely spy the pudding
beneath the
cascade of snowy whipped
cream. It looks so
velvety!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What's more, it's only being offered today?! Gulp...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, as of late I've been feeling my
weight
climb, if just oh-so slightly. I... I
must use my iron
will to resist this
temptation!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
choice_data_list: 意志の力で自分に勝とう！

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I am triumphant! Yes, it was a
complete shutout!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer, let's go for a run! Right
now! I must
pour all this energy into
something!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen demonstrates
insurmountable
focus against her dietary
threat. In fact, she's in
even better
condition than before.
